name: LEGO Robotics
LEGO 机器人
status: Core learning pathway · Ask about availability
核心学习方向 · 请咨询开班情况
intro: Big ideas start with a first build.
从第一次搭建，开始探索大想法。
description: Connect mechanisms, motors and code. Learn to build a robot, explain what it does, and improve how reliably it works.
将机械结构、电机与代码连接起来。学习搭建机器人、解释它的工作方式，并不断提高运行可靠性。
skills: Explore gears, movement and sturdy structures.
探索齿轮、运动与稳定结构。
Use sequences, loops and sensor inputs to control a robot.
使用顺序、循环与传感器输入控制机器人。
Test one change at a time and explain the result.
每次测试一个改动，并解释结果。
challenge: Design a robot to carry an object to a target. Compare routes, adjust the mechanism and record what improves each attempt.
设计一个将物品运到目标位置的机器人。比较路线、调整机构，记录每次尝试的改进。
entry: Beginners can start with building and block coding. Learners with experience can discuss sensor-based challenges and a suitable starting level.
初学者可以从搭建和图形化编程开始；有经验的学生可咨询传感器任务和适合自己的起点。

name: World Robot Olympiad
World Robot Olympiad
status: 未来学习方向 · 登记意向
intro: Three categories. One shared goal: think like an engineer.
三个类别，共同的目标：像工程师一样思考。
description: Prepare for the World Robot Olympiad across three category formats—mission-based robots, a self-driving vehicle challenge and real-world research projects—each with its own age division, team size and judging focus.
通过三种竞赛类别为 World Robot Olympiad 做准备——任务型机器人、自动驾驶车辆挑战与真实问题研究项目——每个类别都有各自的年龄分组、队伍人数与评分重点。
skills: RoboMission (Grades 4–12) — teams of 2–3 build and program a LEGO-based robot to complete missions on a themed field within a time limit, judged on reliable, autonomous task completion.
RoboMission（4–12 年级）— 2–3 人小组搭建并编程基于 LEGO 的机器人，在限定时间内于主题场地完成任务，依据任务完成的可靠性与自主执行能力评分。
Future Engineers (Grades 8–12) — teams of 2 design and program a self-driving vehicle to navigate a standardized track, judged on obstacle avoidance, lane following and parking.
Future Engineers（8–12 年级）— 2 人小组设计并编程自动驾驶车辆，在标准化赛道上行驶，依据避障、循线与泊车表现评分。

Future Innovators (Grades 4–12) — teams of 3–5 research a real-world problem and prototype a robotics or technology solution, judged on creativity, critical thinking, communication and the design process.
Future Innovators（4–12 年级）— 3–5 人小组研究真实问题，设计机器人或技术解决方案原型，依据创造力、批判性思维、表达与设计过程评分。
project: 准备一次 RoboMission 风格的挑战演练
challenge: Build and program a robot to complete a themed mission field within a time limit, then refine it across repeated timed runs—the core loop behind most WRO categories.
搭建并编程机器人，在限定时间内完成主题任务场地挑战，并通过反复计时演练不断改进——这是大多数 WRO 类别的核心训练方式。
entry: Open to learners with some LEGO Robotics or coding experience who want a competition-oriented challenge. Team size and age division follow the category chosen; which category, and any team placement, is discussed individually. This page is preparation, not event registration.
适合有一定 LEGO 机器人或编程基础、希望挑战竞赛方向的学生。队伍人数和年龄分组取决于所选类别；具体选择哪个类别及战队安排需单独沟通。本页面用于备赛准备，并非赛事报名。

name: Distilled Series
Distilled 系列
status: 未来学习方向 · 登记意向
description: A concise, project-based look at computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering—for a high schooler weighing university majors, not exam prep.
面向正在考虑大学专业方向的高中生：以简明讲解和小项目，介绍计算机科学、计算机工程、电子工程与机械工程等工程专业究竟在做什么。
skills: Compare how each discipline frames the same kind of problem.
比较不同学科如何看待同一类问题。
Work through short, visual explanations of core ideas instead of a full semester of theory.
通过简明图解学习核心概念，而非一整学期的理论。
Try a small project in more than one discipline to see what the work actually feels like.
在不止一个学科中尝试小项目，体会真实的工作方式。
project: 从四个视角，设计同一个装置
challenge: Take one simple device and look at it four ways: how a computer scientist would model its logic, a computer engineer would design its circuit and firmware, an electrical engineer would handle its power and signals, and a mechanical engineer would design its housing and moving parts.
围绕同一个简单装置，从四个角度分析：计算机科学如何梳理逻辑，计算机工程如何设计电路与固件，电子工程如何处理电源与信号，机械工程如何设计外壳与机构。
entry: Designed for high school learners exploring university-level engineering and computer science paths. This is major exploration, not exam or credential preparation; ask TTW about the current format before enrolling.
面向希望了解大学工程与计算机科学方向的高中生，用于专业探索，并非应试或考证课程；报名前请向 TTW 咨询当前形式。

name: 3D Design & Printing
3D 设计与打印
grade: 7–9 年级 · 高中 · 成人
status: 未来学习方向 · 登记意向
intro: From an idea to a part you designed.
从一个想法，到亲手设计的零件。
description: Start with shapes and dimensions, then explore fit, function and iteration. Printing becomes one step in a thoughtful design process.
从形状和尺寸开始，探索配合、功能和迭代。让打印成为完整设计过程中的一步。
skills: Turn a sketch into a digital model.
将草图变成数字模型。
Use measurements to design for a purpose.
用测量数据进行有目的的设计。
Compare a prototype with its intended fit and improve it.
将原型与预期配合效果比较，并改进。
challenge: Sketch an attachment, model its dimensions and consider how it fits. Test a prototype and revise the design using measurements.
绘制附件草图，建立尺寸模型并考虑装配。测试原型，再根据测量结果修改设计。
entry: Introductory design and advanced CAD require different starting points. Share the learner’s grade and experience to hear about suitable future options.
入门设计与进阶 CAD 的起点不同。请提供学生年级及经验，了解合适的未来课程。

name: DTF Printing
DTF 转印
grade: 7–9 年级 · 高中 · 成人
status: 未来学习方向 · 登记意向
intro: From a design file to a wearable transfer.
从设计文件，到可穿戴的转印图案。
description: Learn how direct-to-film (DTF) printing turns a digital design into a durable, full-colour transfer that can be pressed onto fabric. Understand the process from file prep to finished press.
学习直喷转印膜（DTF）技术如何把数字设计变成可以压烫到织物上的耐用全彩转印图案，了解从文件准备到压烫成品的完整流程。
skills: Prepare artwork for print: resolution, colour and file format.
为印刷准备设计稿：分辨率、色彩与文件格式。
Understand the DTF process: printing, powder application and curing.
理解 DTF 工艺流程：打印、上粉与固化。
Press a transfer correctly: temperature, pressure and timing.
正确压烫转印：温度、压力与时间控制。
project: Design and press a custom transfer
设计并压烫一件定制转印作品
challenge: Design a small graphic, prepare the file for DTF printing, and press it onto a sample fabric piece. Compare results and adjust settings for a cleaner result.
设计一个小图案，为 DTF 打印准备文件，并压烫到样布上。比较效果，调整参数以获得更好的成品。
entry: A hands-on production skill for learners comfortable following safety steps around heat and equipment. Age suitability, group size and equipment access will be confirmed individually before enrollment.
这是一项需要遵循设备与高温操作安全规范的动手技能课程。适合年龄、班级人数和设备使用安排将在报名前单独确认。

name: UV Printing
UV 打印
grade: 7–9 年级 · 高中 · 成人
status: 未来学习方向 · 登记意向
intro: Print directly onto a surface, cured by UV light.
直接印在物体表面，用紫外光固化。
description: Learn how UV printers apply ink directly onto rigid or flexible surfaces—like acrylic, wood or metal—and cure it instantly with UV light. Explore how material, ink layers and finish affect the result.
学习 UV 打印机如何将油墨直接印在亚克力、木材、金属等硬质或软质表面，并用紫外光即时固化。探索材质、油墨层次与效果之间的关系。
skills: Prepare a design file for a specific surface and print area.
为特定材质与印刷范围准备设计文件。
Understand how UV-cured ink layers, gloss and texture affect a finished piece.
理解 UV 固化油墨的层次、光泽与质感如何影响成品。
Test print settings on sample materials before a final run.
在样品材料上测试打印参数，再进行正式印刷。
project: Print a custom design on a rigid surface
在硬质材料上印制一件定制作品
challenge: Choose a small object or material sample, prepare a design file sized to fit it, and print a test piece. Compare colour and finish against the original design and adjust.
选择一件小物品或材料样品，准备适配尺寸的设计文件，并打印一件测试作品。将颜色和效果与原设计比较并作出调整。
entry: A hands-on production skill involving printing equipment. Age suitability, group size and equipment access will be confirmed individually before enrollment.
这是一项涉及打印设备操作的动手技能课程。适合年龄、班级人数和设备使用安排将在报名前单独确认。

name: Robotics for Adults
成人机器人
status: 未来工作坊 · 登记意向
intro: 动手搭建，不只是孩子的事。
description: A hands-on introduction to robotics for adult beginners—build a working robot, write the code that drives it, and get comfortable with the tools, without needing a technical background.
面向成人初学者的机器人入门课程——搭建一台真正能运行的机器人，编写驱动它的代码，熟悉相关工具，不需要任何技术背景。
skills: Build a stable mechanical structure from a kit.
用套件搭建稳定的机械结构。
Write and test simple code to control motors and sensors.
编写并测试简单代码，控制电机与传感器。
Debug a robot that isn’t working as expected, one step at a time.
逐步调试运行不如预期的机器人。
project: Build a robot that reacts to its surroundings
搭建一台能对环境做出反应的机器人
challenge: Build a robot with a sensor, then program it to respond—stop, turn or speed up—based on what the sensor detects. Test it in a few different situations and adjust.
搭建一台带传感器的机器人，并编程让它根据传感器检测到的情况做出反应——停止、转向或加速。在不同情境下测试并调整。
entry: No prior experience needed. Evening or weekend session format, group size and pacing are still being planned; ask TTW about the current format before enrolling.
无需任何基础。晚间或周末班的具体形式、班级人数和进度仍在规划中；报名前请向 TTW 咨询当前安排。

name: IELTS Preparation
雅思备考
status: 未来学习方向 · 登记意向
intro: Prepare for all four sections of IELTS.
备考雅思四个考试板块。
description: Work through the Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking sections of the IELTS exam, with practice tasks and feedback aimed at a clear target band score.
围绕雅思考试的听力、阅读、写作与口语四个板块进行练习，并针对目标分数提供反馈。
skills: Practise exam-style Listening and Reading tasks under timed conditions.
在限时条件下练习听力与阅读的真题式题型。
Structure Writing Task 1 and Task 2 responses clearly and support them with evidence.
清晰组织写作 Task 1 与 Task 2 的答题结构，并用论据支撑。
Build Speaking fluency and coherence through structured practice and feedback.
通过结构化练习与反馈，提升口语的流利度与连贯性。
project: Complete a full practice test and score review
完成一套完整模拟测试并进行评分回顾
challenge: Take a timed, full-length practice test across all four sections, then review the results section by section to identify the highest-impact areas to improve before the next attempt.
完成一套限时的完整模拟测试（四个板块），逐项回顾结果，找出下次备考中最值得优先提升的部分。
entry: Suited to high school and adult learners preparing for study, work or immigration requirements. Current target band, class format and schedule are not yet confirmed; ask TTW before enrolling.
适合为留学、工作或移民需求做准备的高中生及成人学习者。目前的目标分数、班级形式和排期尚未确认；报名前请向 TTW 咨询。

name: Grades 3–6
3–6 年级
description: A welcoming starting point for curious builders. Explore mechanisms, build a first robot and discover how instructions become movement.
为好奇的小创客提供友好的起点。探索机械结构，搭建第一台机器人，发现指令如何变成运动。
focus: Curiosity, clear explanations and the confidence to try again.
培养好奇心、清晰表达和再次尝试的信心。

name: Grades 7–9
7–9 年级
description: Move from a build that works once to a system that works reliably. Investigate sensors, calibration and structured debugging.
从偶尔成功的作品走向可靠运行的系统，探索传感器、校准和有步骤的调试。
focus: Independent problem solving, repeatable tests and understanding why.
培养独立解决问题、重复测试以及理解原理的能力。

name: High School
高中
verb: 发现 · 深入 · 创造
description: Explore engineering interests through CAD design and a concise look at university-level engineering paths. The intended pathway builds toward documented, independent project work.
通过 CAD 设计与大学工程方向的精炼导览探索工程兴趣。规划中的学习路径将逐步走向有完整记录的独立项目。
focus: Engineering judgement, design decisions and a record of iteration. No university credit or admission outcome is promised.
培养工程判断、设计决策和迭代记录能力。不承诺大学学分或录取结果。
status: 未来学习方向 · 登记意向

name: Adult
成人
description: Interested in practical design, digital modeling or making? Tell TTW what you would like to learn so future workshops can reflect real interests.
对实用设计、数字建模或动手创造感兴趣？告诉 TTW 您想学习的内容，为未来工作坊提供方向。
focus: Goal-led learning for adult beginners and returning makers. Adult workshops are not currently scheduled.
面向成人初学者和重返创作的爱好者，以目标驱动学习。目前成人工作坊尚未排期。
